questions.question: Explain the order in which you should read a bar graph and why.
questions.expected_answer: First read the title to know what is being counted, then the axis labels, then the scale. Only then read the bars, going straight across from the top of each bar to the scale. Reading the bars first can lead to answers about the wrong thing or with the wrong scale.

questions.question: A pie chart for 40 learners shows soccer as a half, netball as a quarter, cricket as an eighth and athletics as an eighth. How many learners chose each sport?
questions.expected_answer: Soccer: half of 40 is 20. Netball: 40 divided by 4 is 10. Cricket: 40 divided by 8 is 5. Athletics: 5. Check: 20 plus 10 plus 5 plus 5 is 40.

questions.question: The tuck shop sold 24, 18, 20, 16 and 34 vetkoek from Monday to Friday. How many more were sold on Friday than on Thursday, and how many in the whole week?
questions.expected_answer: Friday minus Thursday is 34 minus 16, which is 18 more. The week's total is 24 plus 18 plus 20 plus 16 plus 34, which is 112.
